title: FYI Yachts Delivers Results With a Diverse Range of Sales
description: FYI Yachts delivers diverse yacht sales, from center consoles and sportfishers to luxury Sunreef catamarans, offering tailored results for buyers and sellers.
html:
At FYI Yachts, we take pride in delivering results across every segment of the yachting market. Our most recent sales combine performance, innovation, and timeless design — and they highlight the dedication our team brings to every transaction.

The 2021 Sea Fox 328 Commander recently changed hands, with Eduardo Rodriguez representing the buyer and Arney Mendez representing the seller handling the deal. This model is a center console built for both serious fishing and refined cruising. It features a 32-foot LOA, a 10′8″ beam, and a deadrise of 22.5 degrees. With a fuel capacity of over 300 gallons and power options up to 900 horsepower, the 328 Commander delivers speed, range, and versatility. Designed for comfort on the water, it offers plenty of seating, abundant storage, and a wide array of fishing amenities, making it a favorite among boaters who want it all.

The 2017 Pursuit 325 OS, closed by Jose Noy, is another standout from our recent transactions. This model is well regarded for balancing offshore performance with comfortable amenities. Measuring 34′6″ with a 10′10″ beam and a 300-gallon fuel tank, the Pursuit 325 OS reaches speeds over 40 knots while offering thoughtful cruising accommodations. With a spacious cabin, galley, and enclosed head, it’s equally suited for weekend getaways as it is for offshore runs.

Another highlight was the sale of the 2016 Sunreef 70 Power Catamaran, completed by Jose Noy and Ralph Navarro. The Sunreef 70 Power is a true luxury motor cat designed for long-range exploration. With a beam of over 37 feet, expansive interior volume, and the ability to accommodate multiple staterooms, this yacht delivers the innovation, comfort, and range Sunreef is known for. Its layout provides remarkable outdoor living areas and panoramic views, making it ideal for extended cruising or entertaining in complete luxury.

The 2011 Sea Ray 47, sold with the guidance of Eduardo Rodriguez, also found a new owner. The 47 Sea Ray blends sleek styling with reliable performance, making it a trusted choice for coastal cruising and weekend escapes. Highlights include a spacious salon, well-equipped galley, and inviting cockpit, ensuring comfort whether underway or at anchor. Its combination of performance and amenities has made it a timeless option for discerning boaters.

The Sunseeker 72, closed by Ralph Navarro, continues to showcase the appeal of this iconic British brand. A hallmark of Sunseeker design, the 72 combines striking lines, performance hulls, and a spacious interior for an unmatched yachting experience. With generous accommodations, expansive deck spaces, and a design focused on both luxury and performance, it remains a highly desirable yacht in its class.

The 2022 De Antonio Yachts D42, sold by Arney Mendez, brought a touch of contemporary style to our recent lineup of closings. Noted for its hidden outboard engines, walkaround deck, and bold modern design, the D42 is a standout in the day-yacht segment. It offers social deck spaces, a bright and open interior, and impressive speed, making it the perfect blend of cutting-edge styling and versatile performance.

Rounding out this series of sales was the 1997 Bertram 60 EB, closed by Giovanni Tummolillo. A legendary sportfishing model, the 60 EB is built to perform in demanding offshore conditions. Combining durability, seaworthiness, and tournament-level capability, it remains one of the most respected designs among serious anglers. With a proven hull and powerful engines, it’s a boat built for those who demand the very best in sportfishing.

The FYI Advantage

These recent closings underscore FYI’s capability to handle diverse yacht types — from offshore center consoles and luxury multihulls to performance motor yachts and classic sportfishers. Our brokers consistently deliver tailored service and results, whatever the vessel.

If you’re ready to see a SOLD sign on your yacht, it’s time to list with FYI.
